questions.question: D-001 says the first-tick cycle is unspecified but bounded by prescale+1+4 cycles after the write response. Is the 4-cycle margin a register-write-to-timer-enable latency or a general tolerance? It matters for the 'once every prescale+1 cycles' check right after active_0 is set.

o_intr_timer_expired is allowed to differ from IS_0 AND IE_0 for 2 cycles after a change, but IS_0 itself has a 4-cycle latency. Is the 2-cycle window counted from the IS_0/IE_0 register change or from the triggering event? Is it measured at the interface?
The D-009 quote is cut off at 'no more pulses than'. Please confirm the limit is the number of fatal_fault writes.
